question: A common clinical sign of Wilson's disease is:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Copper accumulation in tissues" -> "Liver dysfunction" -> "Kayser-Fleischer rings" -> 95% CHAIN: "Copper deposition in the cornea" -> "Kayser-Fleischer rings" -> 90% CHAIN: "Impaired copper excretion" -> "Copper buildup in the body" -> "Kayser-Fleischer rings" -> 95%
analysis: Wilson's disease is a genetic disorder that results in copper accumulation in various tissues, particularly the liver and brain. One of the common clinical signs of Wilson's disease is the presence of Kayser-Fleischer rings, which are golden-brown rings that appear in the cornea of the eye due to copper deposition.
